about: PROPOSAL: fields the hand-picked seed events of data/events.json lack, derived from Wikidata and Wikipedia the way scripts/enrich-candidates.js derives them for discovered events (scripts/enrich-seed.js). `set` lists only fields the event does not have; titles, extracts, dates, countries and coordinates are not touched. `node scripts/enrich-seed.js --apply` writes a proposal into data/events.json only where the event's date agrees with Wikidata (or a verified F13/F14 entry of docs/data-fixes.md settles it); after such a run this file lists only the events left as they are.
